electric-cobalt.$description: Electric Cobalt — Primary action fill — CTA buttons, active nav state, the single switched-on color in an otherwise muted system

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Brand illustration accent — decorative fills in the hero artwork and supporting graphics, echoes the cobalt at lower saturation

parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas — warm off-white background that gives the whole site its editorial, paper-like quality

snow.$description: Snow — Card surfaces, text on dark backgrounds, product thumbnail containers

ice-wash.$description: Ice Wash — Tinted card surface — subtle blue-white variant for differentiated cards (logo bar, feature callouts)

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Decorative card wash — pale blue background for illustration overlays and feature card accents

lemon-wash.$description: Lemon Wash — Decorative card wash — warm yellow tint for illustration card backgrounds and feature highlights

blush.$description: Blush — Decorative card wash — soft pink for illustration card backgrounds

buttercream.$description: Buttercream — Decorative card wash — warm cream-yellow for illustration card backgrounds

azure.$description: Azure — Illustration accent — mid-blue used in hero artwork and data visualization elements

slate-blue.$description: Slate Blue — Illustration accent — muted blue for decorative borders and secondary graphic elements

amber.$description: Amber — Illustration accent — warm dark-yellow for decorative graphic elements

lilac-pop.$description: Lilac Pop — Illustration accent — vivid lavender for hero artwork highlights

deep-cobalt.$description: Deep Cobalt — Illustration accent — darker blue for hero artwork depth and contrast

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Primary text, hairline borders, high-contrast edges

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, body copy on light surfaces — softer than pure black for reading comfort

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

ash.$description: Ash — Muted text — captions, helper text, secondary metadata

fog.$description: Fog — Borders, dividers, disabled state outlines, muted link text

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter.$description: Workhorse body and UI text — body copy at 400, buttons/labels at 500-600, bold callouts at 700. The font's open apertures and tall x-height make it readable at 12-16px on the warm canvas

inter-variable.$description: Display and heading sizes — 60px display headlines, 38px section headers, 30px subheadings. Weight stays at 400 even at display size: the headlines whisper rather than shout, authority through scale not weight

geist.$description: Small bold labels — compact uppercase-style tags and category markers at 14px weight 600
